title: SearchTextFrame
description: `POST /search/text`: one line of the NDJSON stream (plan 11, B-10, D-02). In the domain this is a discriminated union by `type` (`file` carries `path`/`matches`/`contextLines`; `end` carries `truncated`/`skipped`; `error` carries `code`/`messageKey`/`params`), which the generator cannot express as a `oneOf`; flattened here, with the pairing documented per field (plan 28, B-48). The stream always ends with exactly one `end` or `error` line.

path.description: Present exactly when `type` is `file`. Relative to the folder, with /.

preview.description: A window around the match, cropped to a ceiling (S-66) — never the whole line.

previewMatchStart.description: Where the match starts inside preview, in UTF-16 units.

previewMatchEnd.description: Where the match ends inside preview, in UTF-16 units.

contextLines.description: Present exactly when `type` is `file`. Empty unless the request asked for context lines.

skipped.description: Present exactly when `type` is `end`. Files the engine reported as binary, excluded from the results (S-67) — never a count of files the walk itself silently excluded, which carries no per-file signal.

code.description: Present exactly when `type` is `error`. The same `code` a `502 SEARCH_ENGINE_FAILED` would carry before the first byte.

params.description: Present exactly when `type` is `error`. Open: the parameters of the message, by key.
